p.i: animi M. tuæ in Domino addictissimi, & paratissimi, pro eo ac debeo, & pro modulo mearum virium, ad obsequendum M. tuæ quacunque in re, & quàm potest fieri, submisse. Sed quid est in quo ego M. tuæ queo inseruire magis, quàm in eo, vt assiduis & seriis cum Deo meo precibus agā, vt tu ipsius gratia ac beneficio singulari, virorum qui hoc nostro sæculo doctrina & pietate excellunt apud exteras gentes, opinionem illam præclaram, quam non immeritò sustines, ad extremum usque tueari: vt, & in præsenti hac vita fœliciter regnes,

page.notes: The running head "EPISTOLA" is set in spaced capitals above the text. The last line "nes," is set right-aligned and is the end of a sentence carried over. Some marks (e.g. "submisse" with superscript flourish) are as printed. The word "potest" and "agā" retain the printed abbreviation mark.
